summary.one_liner: Haystack is a modular search library for Django that gives one common API across multiple pluggable search backends.
summary.what_it_does: Provides a unified, familiar search API for Django projects so different search engines can be swapped in without changing application code. The README names Solr, Elasticsearch, Whoosh, and Xapian as example backends. It says it works with third-party Django apps without requiring source modifications. Advanced features listed are faceting, More Like This, highlighting, spatial search, and spelling suggestions. The README is mostly links and does not go into setup or usage detail; those are in the external documentation.
use_cases: add search to a Django website
switch between Solr, Elasticsearch, Whoosh, or Xapian backends
faceted search in a Django app
find similar items with More Like This
notable: One search API that works across several backends without code changes
Works with third-party Django apps without modifying their source
Supports faceting, More Like This, highlighting, spatial search, and spelling suggestions
Listed under the Search category of vinta/awesome-python
caveats: Each backend has its own additional requirements, which the README refers to external docs for
README gives no install commands; setup details live in the external documentation
